title: Correct μ₁ value
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly compute μ₁ = 11/12 or approximately 0.92 using the acceleration from the incline and Newton's second law.

title: Correct total time
description: Essential Criteria: The student must find the total time on the conveyor belt as 1.5 s, summing the acceleration and constant velocity phases.

title: Correct scratch length
description: Essential Criteria: The student must calculate the length of the scratch (relative displacement) as 2 m.

title: Incline acceleration analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly determine the block's deceleration on the incline using kinematics or energy, leading to a₁.

title: Conveyor acceleration phase
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply Newton's second law on the belt to find a₂ = μ₂g and analyze the time/distance until speeds match.

title: Relative motion concept
description: Important Criteria: The student must recognize that the scratch length equals the belt's displacement minus the block's displacement during slippage.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s²) throughout the calculation.

title: Sign error in friction
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses an incorrect sign for friction force on the incline or conveyor, leading to wrong acceleration direction.

title: Ignoring uniform motion phase
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student assumes the block stops accelerating upon matching the belt's speed and neglects the remaining distance L₂ - x₁.
